plan.summary: Provision a containerized stream processing workload on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Autopilot with Workload Identity Federation, Cloud Pub/Sub, and Firestore.
plan.architecture_overview: A GKE Autopilot cluster running in us-central1 orchestrates Python asyncio stream processing pods within the stream-apps namespace. Pods authenticate securely using Google Cloud Workload Identity Federation via a Kubernetes Service Account mapped to a dedicated IAM Service Account with roles/pubsub.subscriber and roles/datastore.user. The workload pulls message batches from a Cloud Pub/Sub pull subscription, aggregates latency and throughput over tumbling windows, and writes metrics to Firestore.

infra_tasks.title: Enable Google Cloud APIs and Configure VPC Subnet
infra_tasks.description: Enable container.googleapis.com, artifactregistry.googleapis.com, pubsub.googleapis.com, firestore.googleapis.com, and configure workload VPC subnet.
acceptance_criteria: Subnet allocated for GKE Autopilot cluster

infra_tasks.title: Provision Artifact Registry, Pub/Sub, and Firestore State
infra_tasks.description: Create Artifact Registry Docker repository, Pub/Sub topic stream-ingest-topic, pull subscription stream-gke-sub, and default Firestore database.

infra_tasks.title: Provision GKE Autopilot Cluster and Workload Identity IAM Bindings
infra_tasks.description: Deploy GKE Autopilot cluster with Workload Identity enabled, bind sa-stream-worker to dedicated GSA, and synthesize Kubernetes manifests for stream-apps namespace, Deployment, and HPA.

code_tasks.title: Implement Asyncio Pub/Sub Stream Processing Worker
code_tasks.description: Implement Python asyncio worker consuming batches of 50 messages from stream-gke-sub, computing window metrics, and writing time-series aggregates to Firestore stream_metrics with HTTP health probe endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP liveness and readiness probes respond with 200 OK

code_tasks.title: Configure Container Build and Deployment CI/CD Pipeline
code_tasks.description: Configure GitHub Actions pipeline with Workload Identity Federation to build container images to Artifact Registry and update Kubernetes deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Container image pushed to Artifact Registry

code_tasks.title: Implement Automated Unit and Integration Test Suite
code_tasks.description: Implement pytest test cases with mocks for google-cloud-pubsub streaming pull and google-cloud-firestore client.

sequenced_build_plan.title: GKE Autopilot Stream Processor Build Plan
sequenced_build_plan.summary: Deployment of GKE Autopilot cluster, Workload Identity Federation, Artifact Registry, Cloud Pub/Sub, and Python asyncio stream processing application.

steps.title: Enable Google Cloud Service APIs
steps.description: Enable GKE, Artifact Registry, Pub/Sub, Firestore, and IAM service APIs with disable_on_destroy set to false.
acceptance_criteria: All required service APIs declared in OpenTofu configuration

steps.title: Provision Cloud Pub/Sub and Firestore Database
steps.description: Provision Cloud Pub/Sub topic stream-ingest-topic, pull subscription stream-gke-sub, and Native Firestore database.
acceptance_criteria: Pub/Sub topic and pull subscription created

steps.title: Provision Artifact Registry Docker Repository
steps.description: Create standard Docker repository stream-workloads in us-central1.

steps.title: Configure Service Account and Workload Identity Binding
steps.description: Provision workload Google Service Account with roles/pubsub.subscriber and roles/datastore.user, bound to Kubernetes Service Account sa-stream-worker via workloadIdentityUser.
acceptance_criteria: GSA created with least privilege roles

steps.title: Implement Asyncio Streaming Worker Application
steps.description: Implement Python asyncio worker consuming batches from Pub/Sub, aggregating 1-minute metrics into Firestore stream_metrics, and exposing health probes.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP health endpoints respond on port 8080

steps.title: Configure GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline
steps.description: Create GitHub Actions workflow with WIF authentication and path filtering to build container images to Artifact Registry.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow builds container image on push to application directory

steps.title: Provision GKE Autopilot Cluster and Kubernetes Manifests
steps.description: Provision GKE Autopilot cluster, stream-apps namespace, sa-stream-worker ServiceAccount, stream-processor-deployment with 250m CPU / 512Mi memory requests, and HorizontalPodAutoscaler.
acceptance_criteria: Autopilot cluster created with Workload Identity

steps.title: Implement Unit and Integration Tests
steps.description: Write pytest test cases with mocked Pub/Sub pull messages and Firestore persistence verification.
acceptance_criteria: Pytest passes with 100% mock assertion success

plan.risk_assessment: GKE Autopilot cluster provisioning is a heavy stateful infrastructure operation requiring elevated project permissions and extended provisioning time. Workload Identity configuration and Kubernetes manifest synthesis require careful coordination to ensure pod security and zero secret exposure.
